cases.reply: You can return most items within 30 days of delivery. The 30 days start on the date the order was delivered, not the date it was ordered. (Source: Returns and Refunds › Return window)

Refunds go back to the original payment method within 5 to 7 business days after the returned item arrives at our warehouse and passes inspection. Card statements can take another 2 to 3 business days to show the refund. (Source: Returns and Refunds › Refund timing)
Returns for a change of mind cost 5,000 KRW, which is deducted from the refund. Returns of defective, damaged or wrong items are free. (Source: Returns and Refunds › Return shipping cost)
We ship to Japan, Singapore, the United States and Germany. International delivery takes 7 to 14 business days. (Source: Shipping and Delivery › International shipping)
Express delivery arrives the next business day if you order before 2 pm KST. Express costs 6,000 KRW. (Source: Shipping and Delivery › Express delivery)

You can cancel an order free of charge while its status is "processing", before it ships. Once an order has shipped it cannot be cancelled; please use the return process after delivery instead. (Source: Orders, Cancellations and Payments › Cancelling an order)
Tents carry a 2-year warranty. Jackets, backpacks, sleeping bags and footwear carry a 1-year warranty. (Source: Warranty › Warranty period)

We accept Visa, Mastercard and American Express credit or debit cards, mobile payments and bank transfer. Payment is taken when the order is placed. (Source: Orders, Cancellations and Payments › Payment methods)
Students get 10% off their first order after verifying their student status on the website. (Source: Frequently Asked Questions › Do you have a student discount?)
Yes. Digital gift cards from 10,000 to 500,000 KRW are valid for 5 years and cannot be returned or exchanged for cash. (Source: Frequently Asked Questions › Do you offer gift cards?)
